name: VoltScope
subtitle: Battery telemetry for iPhone and compatible Bluetooth accessories
description: Unsigned native iOS builds. Sign using FlareStore or EmberSign. On-device private HID sensors may provide charging data without jailbreak; health, cycles and discharge current remain restricted.

apps.name: VoltScope
apps.subtitle: Battery diagnostics and connected-device monitoring
apps.localizedDescription: Measured charging input and battery-side power via read-only private HID sensors when available, local history and drain trends, Bluetooth and FindMyBLE LARQ cache, and device widgets.

versions.localizedDescription: Read-only on-device HID sensor probe for measured USB-C charging input, battery cell current and voltage, and temperature where exposed. Includes FindMyBLE handoff and device-ring widgets.
versions.changelog: Measured USB-C input watts, current and voltage separately from battery charging power. Three-second foreground refresh, sensor-key diagnostics, device-specific icons and FindMyBLE integration. Missing and partial readings stay blank.
